name: @olai/surface
//dependencies: @olai/format for the domain's wire vocabulary, and @olai/acp's `./wire` subpath for the protocol's — the surface is a declaration, and every olai type on the wire is owned by the package that speaks it and re-exported here (RepoState through format, the ask shapes through acp). @kolu/surface is absent on purpose: it is hydrated from the Nix store rather than installed from bun.lock, so it is declared once for the whole tree in the root package.json (see bunfig.toml).
